command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
R=chr20:1000000-3000000
T0=$(date +%s)
bcftools mpileup -f chr20.fa -r $R NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -Ou 2> bc.log | bcftools call -mv -Oz -o out.vcf.gz 2>> bc.log
T1=$(date +%s)
N=$(bcftools view -H out.vcf.gz | wc -l)
{ echo "tool bcftools"; echo "region $R"; echo "wall_s $(( T1 - T0 ))"; echo "variants $N"; echo "mb_per_min $(awk -v s=$(( T1 - T0 )) 'BEGIN{if(s>0)printf \"%.2f\", 2.0/(s/60)}')"; } > canary.txt
cat canary.txt
test "$N" -gt 1000
echo CANARY_DONE
